title: Dongbei Vegan Lo Rice Bowl
description: A hearty, flavorful bowl filled with Dongbei-style lo, served over rice and topped with crisp vegetables.
instructions: Heat 2 cups of water in a medium saucepan over high heat.
Bring to a boil, then add 1 cup of uncooked rice.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
While the rice cooks, heat 1 tablespoon of Dongbei-style stir-fry sauce in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 cup of sliced bell pepper and 1 cup of sliced carrot to the skillet.
Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Add 1 cup of lo to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until the lo is heated through.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and divide it among bowls.
Top the rice with the lo and vegetable mixture, and garnish with chopped meen chives.
